name: Gibran Museum
scope: Standing Gibran Museum in the former cliffside Mar Sarkis monastery at Bsharri, Lebanon, including the valley-facing arcaded entry, stepped stone volumes and terrace edge.
era: Standing monastery and twentieth-century museum extensions, using the southwest photograph uploaded in 2006 and present mapped footprint.

originalReview.notes: Southwest photograph documents the golden rough masonry, deeply recessed narrow windows and stone relieving arches, broad lowered semicircular entry, stepped flat roofs, terrace railing and steep limestone rear outcrops.

review.method: Exact Qualla original and recorded author public-domain release
review.notes: Used the exact Qualla original, a photographer-released public-domain southwest view of the existing restored museum. The art image was outside the scope of the building model.
